item.title: Ninaivu 0.4.3
item.description:
• The popover shows only Favorites (starred chips) instead of every recent reminder; the section is hidden when there are none. Right-click an upcoming reminder › Add to Favorites to star it.
  • The footer's Notes button matches Settings and Quit.

item.title: Ninaivu 0.4.2
item.description:
• Fix: Pill size now redraws the pill at the new size (it used to resize only the invisible window around a pill that stayed small).
  • Fix: Settings › Deck › Size no longer resizes the resting pill, so Size (tabs), Pill size (pill) and Position (height) each do one thing. Clearer help text under each.

item.title: Ninaivu 0.4.1
item.description:
• Notes deck: a Position slider (top to bottom) in Settings › Deck, and Top / Middle / Bottom in the pill's right-click menu. ⌥-drag still works.
  • Notes deck: Pill size (100–300%) makes the resting pill bigger and easier to find without enlarging the tabs; also in the pill's right-click menu.

item.title: Ninaivu 0.4.0
item.description:
• Notes: sticky notes at the edge of the screen, derived from Noty (MIT, © Aymen Hamza). Edge deck with labelled tabs or colour chips, live Markdown, checkbox tasks, images, pinned and floating notes, quick capture (⇧⌘Space), All Notes and Archive, export/import, optional iCloud Drive sync, encrypted note bodies, twelve rebindable shortcuts, `ninaivu://` URL scheme.
  • Remind me about a note: bell in the note header takes `20m`, `3pm`, `fri 9am`; the "It's time" card gets a Note button that opens it.
  • Settings is one tabbed window: Reminders, Shortcuts, Deck, Notes, Sync, Updates, About.
  • Popover and menu bar menu gain New Note, Quick Capture, All Notes and Archive.

item.title: Ninaivu 0.3.0
item.description:
• Future-dated reminders: `dentist fri 3pm`, `tomorrow 9am`, `oct 3`, `next mon`, `in 3 days`; a date alone means 9 AM.
  • Date and time picker next to the quick entry field.
  • Upcoming list grouped by day (Today, Tomorrow, each later date); recents trimmed to six with Show all.
  • Add time or reschedule: row hover (+5m, +1h, calendar), right-click menu, and a ⋯ menu on the "It's time" card.
  • Settings moved to their own window (gear in the popover, ⌘,, or right-click › Settings…).
  • In-app updates via Sparkle: an "Update available" banner and a menu bar dot; one click installs and relaunches, reminders are kept.
  • Cask marked `auto_updates true`.
